subject.title: fix(feishu): pace outbound sends per target

question: Should the Feishu plugin adopt this permanent default-off, process-local `sendRateLimit.minIntervalMs` contract with top-level inheritance and per-account overrides?
rationale: Code inspection supports the implementation, but only Feishu ownership can accept two lasting public configuration paths and the bounded single-process delivery guarantee.

options.title: Accept bounded contract
options.body: Approve both scopes after documenting inheritance, covered logical sends, process-local limitations, a safe target-rate example, and adding real-runtime proof.

options.title: Narrow to channel scope
options.body: Remove the per-account override unless different intervals per Feishu app are a demonstrated operator requirement.

options.title: Prefer automatic pacing
options.body: Avoid a new operator setting and maintain a Feishu-owned automatic pacing policy alongside existing response-aware retries.

recommendation.title: Accept bounded contract
recommendation.body: Approve both scopes after documenting inheritance, covered logical sends, process-local limitations, a safe target-rate example, and adding real-runtime proof.
